title: A repo-declared protected-path list that the guard enforces
why: Owner ask ask-mw6vyc57pi part 2, 14:58 CST Nov 7. Banchi denies writes to fixtures/ (real TCGplayer exports, ground truth for the round-trip test) with a permissions.deny rule and a PreToolUse hook; neither runs in a project's cloud thread (probe 2026-11-03).
note: A guard rule reads a protected-path list from .claude/layout-extras.json and denies Write/Edit and shell writes under it. Opt-in per repo. Red test first. Guard change, full review rounds.
